summary: Frontend-only landing page 'TTB KING' tested end-to-end at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All required data-testid elements render and Telegram links resolve to https://t.me/+ZRXVYah_r0c5ZGU1 with target=_blank. Meta tags (title, og:title, og:description, og:image) verified after a required frontend restart (see note). Ticker cycles, stats counters render final values, FAQ single-mode accordion works, mobile menu opens and sticky CTA appears after scrolling past hero. Two horizontal-overflow bugs found (mobile 429px vs 390px viewport = FAILS required test; desktop 2112px vs 1920px).

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile horizontal overflow: document.scrollWidth=429px at 390px viewport (~39px overflow). Spec explicitly requires 'no horizontal overflow'. Likely a full-bleed section, marquee, or hero grid causing overflow-x. Add overflow-x: hidden to body/main or fix the offending section width/padding.

Desktop horizontal overflow: document.scrollWidth=2112px at 1920px viewport (~192px overflow). Same root cause (likely marquee / grid pattern / signal card). Users get an unwanted horizontal scrollbar on desktop.

action_items: Fix mobile horizontal overflow (390px viewport shows scrollWidth=429). Inspect Testimonials Marquee, Hero grid pattern, and any translate-x elements; add overflow-x: hidden on the outer wrapper or clip container.
Fix desktop horizontal overflow (1920 -> scrollWidth 2112). Same root cause.

public/index.html changes are NOT picked up by webpack HMR — I had to `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` to get the new title/og meta served. This is environment-specific but note: if the user opened the preview before the restart they'd have seen the default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' title. Main agent should also restart frontend when index.html changes.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate data-testid values between desktop nav and mobile menu links (nav-link-features/results/process/community/faq exist on both). Playwright resolves the hidden desktop link first and click fails. Recommend prefixing mobile menu links with mobile-nav-link-* or keeping single instances via responsive rendering.
public/index.html hot-reload gap: index.html changes require a manual frontend restart in this environment.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all required elements/hrefs/animations pass; mobile+desktop horizontal overflow are the only failures)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All content, hrefs, testids, ticker cycling, stat counters, FAQ single-mode accordion, mobile menu toggle, and mobile sticky CTA verified. Only remaining bug is horizontal overflow on both mobile (39px) and desktop (192px). Re-test by measuring document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs clientWidth at 390 and 1920 viewports. Also revisit duplicate data-testid on mobile vs desktop nav links.
rca of the issue: Mobile/desktop horizontal overflow: likely caused by (a) the Testimonials marquee track exceeding viewport without an overflow-hidden container, (b) hero grid/pattern element wider than viewport, or (c) a translate-x transformed element. Reproduction: open URL, run `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` in console at width 390 -> 429, at 1920 -> 2112. Mitigation: add `overflow-x: hidden` to <main> or body, or constrain the offending marquee/grid width to 100vw with clip-inline containment.
